Bracelets of the Brave

Internal ID: TrinketBlackDamageHealth | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Black metal x5, Lox pelt x5, Lox trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 85 | Effect: 100 health gain | +20 Club skill | +10% Blunt damage | Duration: 1m

Introduction. Bracelets of the Brave is a Plains-tier trinket.

Effects. Once 85 Adrenaline has been gained, the Bracelets of the Brave will trigger automatically, providing 100 health immediately, and +20 Clubs skill and +10% Blunt damage for 60 seconds.
